summary: July payrolls came in weaker than expected, pushing rate-hike bets to December at the earliest and lifting equities toward record territory. A soft dollar is amplifying gold's run, while Section 338 Canada tariffs set for August 19 keep trade risk in the frame.
tweet: Weak jobs data killed near-term hike odds and sent stocks higher, but Canada tariffs land in 11 days — gold and a soft dollar say the market is not fully relaxed.
